component.name: ProbeScene

Label.text: Roku Customer ID Probe running, see the console (port 8085)

component.script:
sub init() m.store = m.top.findNode("store") m.timer = m.top.findNode("timeout") m.store.observeField("requestStatus", "onRequestStatus") m.timer.observeField("fire", "onTimeout") m.gap = m.top.findNode("gap") m.gap.observeField("fire", "nextCase") ' Each case: a label and the request AA to send (invalid = skip the field). m.cases = [ { label: "basic", request: { command: "GetRokuCustomerId" } }, { label: "with context", request: { command: "GetRokuCustomerId", context: { id: "ctx-1", n: 7 } } }, { label: "lowercase command", request: { command: "getrokucustomerid" } }, { label: "padded command", request: { command: " GetRokuCustomerId " } }, { label: "repeat (stable?)", request: { command: "GetRokuCustomerId" } }, { label: "unknown command", request: { command: "NoSuchCommand", context: { id: "bad-1" } } }, { label: "missing command", request: { context: { id: "none-1" } } }, { label: "non-string command", request: { command: 42 } }, ] m.index = -1 m.ids = [] print "[probe] ===== Roku Customer ID Probe =====" di = CreateObject("roDeviceInfo") print "[probe] firmware: "; di.GetOSVersion() print "[probe] model: "; di.GetModel() print "[probe] channelClientId: "; di.GetChannelClientId() nextCase() end sub
sub nextCase() m.timer.control = "stop" m.index = m.index + 1 if m.index >= m.cases.count() finish() return end if c = m.cases[m.index] print "[probe] ----- case "; m.index; ": "; c.label; " -----" print "[probe] request: "; FormatJson(c.request) m.timer.control = "start" m.store.request = c.request end sub
sub onRequestStatus() rs = m.store.requestStatus print "[probe] requestStatus type: "; type(rs) if rs <> invalid and GetInterface(rs, "ifAssociativeArray") <> invalid dump(rs, " ") if rs.result <> invalid and GetInterface(rs.result, "ifAssociativeArray") <> invalid id = rs.result.rokuCustomerId if id <> invalid analyze(id) m.ids.push(id) end if end if else print "[probe] value: "; rs end if m.timer.control = "stop" m.gap.control = "start" end sub
sub onTimeout() print "[probe] TIMEOUT: no requestStatus within 10s" m.gap.control = "start" end sub
' Prints each key with its BrightScript type, recursing into nested AAs. sub dump(aa as object, indent as string) for each key in aa value = aa[key] if value <> invalid and GetInterface(value, "ifAssociativeArray") <> invalid print "[probe] "; indent; key; " ("; type(value); "):" dump(value, indent + " ") else if value <> invalid and GetInterface(value, "ifArray") <> invalid print "[probe] "; indent; key; " ("; type(value); "): "; FormatJson(value) else print "[probe] "; indent; key; " ("; type(value); "): ["; value; "]" end if end for end sub
' Describes the id's shape: length, character classes, dash positions, case. sub analyze(id as dynamic) print "[probe] >> rokuCustomerId type: "; type(id) if GetInterface(id, "ifString") = invalid then return print "[probe] >> length: "; len(id) print "[probe] >> hex32 lowercase: "; CreateObject("roRegex", "^[0-9a-f]{32}$", "").isMatch(id) print "[probe] >> hex32 any case: "; CreateObject("roRegex", "^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$", "").isMatch(id) print "[probe] >> uuid (dashed): "; CreateObject("roRegex", "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$", "").isMatch(id) print "[probe] >> digits only: "; CreateObject("roRegex", "^[0-9]+$", "").isMatch(id) print "[probe] >> has uppercase: "; CreateObject("roRegex", "[A-Z]", "").isMatch(id) end sub
sub finish() print "[probe] ----- summary -----" stable = true for each id in m.ids if id <> m.ids[0] then stable = false end for print "[probe] ids received: "; m.ids.count() print "[probe] all ids identical: "; stable print "[probe] ===== done =====" m.top.findNode("status").text = "Probe finished (" + m.ids.count().toStr() + " ids). See console." end sub
